verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a support article title, "Turn on Live Captions", which shows Windows ships at least one built-in accessibility tool. Nothing in the pack mentions a built-in screen reader or how accessibility tools help during setup or onboarding. Missing for 10: evidence of a built-in screen reader, accessibility options available during setup/OOBE, a broader accessibility toolset beyond captions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
